item.title: Tugboats work to refloat ship blocking the Suez Canal
item.description: Salvage teams and a fleet of tugboats worked overnight to refloat the container ship that blocked the Suez Canal. A salvage master told gCaptain: “We expect to have her floating on the next high tide.” More than 60 ships are now queued at the canal, and the shipping backlog keeps growing.

item.title: Tanker attacked near the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A tanker was struck by a projectile near the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, maritime security officials said. No crew were injured and the tanker continued to port under its own power.

item.title: Container freight rates climb for a third week
item.description: Spot freight rates for containers rose again this week as carriers cut capacity on Asia-Europe routes, a freight index showed.
